meta.name: bids
meta.description: Organizes, queries, validates, and converts Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets. Supports organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把脑影像原始数据整理成规范数据集、校验合规并转换格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有 MRI、脑电等神经影像数据需要按统一标准归档与校验。
copy.tagline_en: Organize raw brain imaging data into validated, standards-compliant datasets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have MRI, EEG, or MEG data to organize and validate under a shared standard.
